resources.string: Other devices on your network can see this screen.
Ropeway saves received files to Download/Ropeway and keeps the shared folder in Documents/Ropeway Shared. Allow access to all files to use them.
Lets a computer you allow tap, swipe and type on this phone.

Ropeway uses this service only while you let a computer on your network control this phone: it performs the taps, swipes, text input and Back / Home presses sent from that computer. Nothing is read or sent otherwise.
